fit out.meaning: Cung cấp các thiết bị cần thiết.
fit out.example: They fitted out the boat for the race.

fit out with.meaning: Cung cấp cho ai đó các thiết bị cần thiết.
fit out with.example: They didn't fit the troops out with the necessary protective gear.

fit up.meaning: Vu oan cho ai đó để họ có vẻ có tội dù không làm.
fit up.example: The police fitted him up for dealing drugs.
They fitted us up with the latest IT.

fix up.example: He fixed up an appointment for me to see a specialist.

fizzle out.meaning: Kết thúc một cách không thành công.
fizzle out.example: The campaign started well, but fizzled out when they ran out of money.

find fault with.meaning: Bắt bẻ, bới lông tìm vết, chê bai.
find fault with.example: Instead of being helpful, she just likes to find fault with others.

fifteen minutes of fame.meaning: Sự nổi tiếng ngắn ngủi, chớp nhoáng.
fifteen minutes of fame.example: His viral video brought him fifteen minutes of fame, but now he's back to his normal life.

fight an uphill battle.meaning: Đấu tranh trong hoàn cảnh khó khăn, gian nan.
fight an uphill battle.example: Starting a new business in this economy feels like fighting an uphill battle.

fight tooth and nail.meaning: Đấu tranh quyết liệt, chiến đấu đến cùng.
fight tooth and nail.example: She fought tooth and nail to get the promotion.

fill in the blanks.meaning: Điền vào chỗ trống, bổ sung thông tin còn thiếu.
fill in the blanks.example: I didn't understand the whole plan, but my manager will fill in the blanks for me.

filthy rich.meaning: Vô cùng giàu có, giàu nứt đố đổ vách.
filthy rich.example: Despite his humble beginnings, he became filthy rich through hard work and innovation.

find your feet.meaning: Trở nên tự tin, quen thuộc với môi trường mới.
find your feet.example: It took her a few months to find her feet in the new company.

finger-lickin' good.meaning: Ngon tuyệt cú mèo, ngon khó cưỡng.
finger-lickin' good.example: The barbecue at that new place is finger-lickin' good! It's worth every penny.

fish out of water.meaning: Người lạc lõng, cảm thấy không thoải mái trong môi trường lạ.
fish out of water.example: At her new job, she felt like a fish out of water, not knowing anyone or how things worked.

fit as a fiddle.meaning: Cực kỳ khỏe mạnh, sung sức.
fit as a fiddle.example: After his recovery from the flu, he is now fit as a fiddle.

fit to be tied.meaning: Cực kỳ tức giận, nổi trận lôi đình.
fit to be tied.example: When she found out her flight was canceled, she was fit to be tied.

fits and starts.meaning: Thất thường, không đều đặn (làm việc chập chờn).
fits and starts.example: Their progress on the project was made in fits and starts.

five o'clock shadow.meaning: Râu mọc lún phún (sau một ngày dài không cạo râu).
five o'clock shadow.example: He had a five o'clock shadow by the time the meeting ended.

fix someone's wagon.meaning: Dạy cho ai đó một bài học, phá đám ai đó.
fix someone's wagon.example: Don't worry, we'll fix their wagon for trying to cheat us.

fixed in one's ways.meaning: Bảo thủ, không chịu thay đổi thói quen.
fixed in one's ways.example: My grandfather is quite fixed in his ways and refuses to use a smartphone.
